releaseNotes: Independent computer PWA copied from the Chrome Android release with the same app data, screens, assets and study functionality.
Desktop layout now uses the full browser/app window instead of the phone-width 430px frame; application controls stay centered within a readable maximum width.
Desktop Chromium install support, user-triggered fullscreen and Screen Wake Lock where supported.
Separate Computer manifest, service-worker cache and resumable offline package with SHA-256 verification.
Native Android alarms, scheduled notifications and the APK foreground timer service are not represented as computer browser features.
